GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , nice trail 5th rails 4 Lengths 800m, came off fence soon after Straightening Up and had big gap to go through at 200m but the run closed when one outside laid in and he had to steady and lost momentum, peeled off heels soon after and in Clear , drove late last couple of strides and Just missed but rider went to stewards room and he won the race on protest # won on protest
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Stewards considered a protest lodged by L. Rolls, rider of the 2nd placegetter Bjorn Ironside, against Starry Jack being declared the winner, alleging interference shortly after entering the straight. After considering all the evidence, Stewards found that Starry Jack shifted out upon entering the straight, allowing Bjorn Ironside to establish a run to its inside, before Starry Jack shifted in, resulting in Bjorn Ironside being obliged to steady and shift out around the heels of that runner to obtain clear running. Protest was upheld.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well . Settled Down 3 Wide With Cover 8th, 6 Lengths @ 800m. in between runners Straightening Up bit closer. came Through found Clear , Sound Finale # Sound Finale
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start shifted in and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Rolled fwd before raced Mid Field on inside (4L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken @ 500m. Chasing Two Wide @ 400m & pushed along 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & challenged leaders @ 200m. Faded in last 100m. blinkers off first time. # Every Chance

Began fairly. Pushed fwd until led on rail by 1 length early . Held lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken on rail @ 400m. Pushed along on inside (1L clear) on home turn. Headed @ 200m & weakened on inside in last 150m. # Led & weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported gelding travelled keenly after beginning on terms and, when likely to be caught wide, was allowed to stride forward and obtain the lead without being overly pressured.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. got up fence turn 4 lengths. weakened # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 150m was obliged to shift out around the heels of a tiring runner to continue into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped ko but got an immediate squeeze. Settled Down Inside 12th, 10 Lengths @ 600m. Same Position into Straight . Just Held Ground way back # always well back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Steadied when buffeted heavily between runners on jumping.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Not Bustled at all settled down third last fence 7 Lengths (800m), shoved along before Turn , Straightened Up Saved Ground fence Under Whip Soon After though, held Ground ok to the line # even effort

Began OK. Pushed fwd & shared lead on rail before Settled Down 3rd on rail (2L from lead) early . Tracked leader on inside midrace & pushed to quicken Two Wide @ 500m. Pushed along Two Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & weakened in last 200m. # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated mount up in distance, from an inside barrier, & he was inst to hold posn behind leaders. Rdr stated mount began only fairly & he rode it along in an effort to ride to his inst. Rdr stated anticipated leader did not show speed he expected, so as to cross his mount & provide cover, & consequently he allowed mount to stride fwd to lead. Rdr stated another runner gradually worked fwd to lead & he took sit back off it in middle stages. Tnr confirmed inst & advised geld had raced in that manner previously. Tnr added would have preferred geld got cover so as to sustain a finsihing effort.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4wide 4len Hard Ridden 600m no finish last 400m # weak in straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After passing the 700m, was hampered and lost ground, as a result of another runner giving ground and shifted out in advance.
